build.buildCommand: npm install && npx prisma generate --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=@qacc/api

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma || npx prisma db push --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma --skip-generate; npx tsx apps/api/prisma/seed.ts; npm run start --workspace=@qacc/api
